core.title: Wall Mounted Glass Toothbrush Holder, Deltana ZA2014

text.description_html:
Deltana ZA2014, ModernValue Glass Tumbler

The contemporary appeal of the Modern Value Series Tumbler can be found both in the contemporary wall mount with its sleek concealed screw design and in the 2 chic finishes in which it is available. The brackets are made of zinc and aluminum (available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes) and the tumbler is made of glass. The modern square mount brings interesting design to the lowly toothbrush holder. It is made with the attention to quality Deltana is known for and when mounted to the wall, this toothbrush tumbler will make an ultra fashionable--yet functional--accessory to any bathroom.

Shop more of the Deltana ZA Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Modern Value Glass Toothbrush Tumbler With Squared Mount:

  • Material: zinc and aluminum wall mount (available in satin nickel or polished chrome) with a white frosted glass tumbler.
  • Height: 3-3/4"
  • Tumbler Opening Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Overall Projection: 5-5/8"
  • Wall Mount Length: 1-1/8" squared
  • Deltana ZA2014 Glass Toothbrush Holder Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 glass tumbler, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
